weighting_artifact.multiplicity_definition: All positive known-TRAIN (root,side) memberships pooled across sides, including BOTH
weighting_artifact.normalization: For each positive joint class solve sum clip(a*raw,0.5,2.0)=original root count; NONE=1; no later renormalization
weighting_artifact.loss_denominator: Number of known roots in batch; not sum of weights
caveats: Class masses are preserved; actual gradient masses may change with prediction errors.
Soft capped identity weights change the TRAIN measure and do not guarantee uniform-root calibration.

uniform_v3_replay.definition: Fresh V4 uniform fit compared with immutable V3 restored-uniform predictions, selected update, initialization, probes, and common sampled TRAIN prefixes; no model reused

protocol.calibration: On known X-admitted CAL NONE roots only: sort scores descending, k=floor(0.05*N_NONE), threshold=nextafter(sorted_scores[k],+infinity) in float64. This is the lowest representable threshold satisfying the inclusive NONE-alert budget; ties are conservative. No positive score, TEST label, or TEST score participates.
protocol.selected_side_tp: alert AND selected side belongs to y; BOTH includes both sides
protocol.wrong_side: selected-side alert AND y>0 AND selected side does not belong to y
protocol.primary_recall: Event true alerts / all known positive event roots; selected-side correct alerts / the SAME all-positive-event denominator
protocol.positive_identity: Equal (side, first qualifying ID) identities on known admitted roots. E alerts cover all true-positive side memberships; selected-side alerts only their correctly selected membership. ID repetition is alerted root-side multiplicity, not duration or independent sample count.
protocol.unknown: Unknown labels remain in coverage/alert counts, never treated as NONE or scored as false alarms
protocol.policy_separation: Signal thresholds are descriptive alarm diagnostics; existing after-cost CAL trading selector is unchanged

economic_policy.policy: max marginal P(LONG)=p1+p3 or P(SHORT)=p2+p3; LONG wins tie; threshold inclusive
economic_policy.selection_scope: CAL only; model selection is external and must use validation
economic_policy.economic_units: USD per reference ounce; taker BBO, no depth/queue/impact claim
economic_policy.drawdown_definition: closed-trade cash peak minus closed cash; excludes intratrade mark-to-market
economic_policy.future_unknown_admission: no y_crossing or future maturity filter in replay

alignment.aligned_complete_validation: all COMPLETE rows, including unused branches

paired.sign: Soft minus uniform utility; +AUC and -NLL/Brier. Positive improves the metric.
paired.interval: Descriptive equal-day paired bootstrap, 20,000 replicates seed20261023; average seeds within a date first. No independence, multiplicity correction, or TEST selection claim.

limitations: Fixed alarms and CAL NONE-FPR thresholds are geometric classification diagnostics, not trading policies.
Known-label cohorts are legitimate scoring cohorts but cannot prefilter live/full-clock execution; UNKNOWN coverage is separate.
Positive-ID diagnostics omit negative roots and cannot establish false-positive control or economic value.
Weight-concentration ESS and crossing multiplicity are not independent sample sizes; day intervals are descriptive.
June/July dates had historical research exposure and V3 evaluation; V4 is a controlled same-block follow-up, not a fresh external holdout.
